# Trim <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Trim:String string:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text. |

**Returns:** The text without the blanks at its ends.

## Description

Removes spaces, tabs and other invisible characters from both ends of a string.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print "[" + Trim$("   hi there  ") + "]"
```

```text
[hi there]
```
